name: Webhook & Event Contracts
description: Webhook & Event Contracts standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-WEBHOOK applies.

rules.title: Authenticate webhook senders
rules.detail: Verify a signature, mTLS, token or equivalent trusted mechanism before processing; never trust source IP alone unless contractually fixed and supplemented.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Authenticate webhook senders.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Authenticate webhook senders.

rules.title: Verify signature against the raw canonical payload
rules.detail: Perform verification before parsing/mutating the payload and apply replay/timestamp protection when supported.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Verify signature against the raw canonical payload.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Verify signature against the raw canonical payload.

rules.title: Acknowledge quickly and process asynchronously when work is non-trivial
rules.detail: Keep provider-facing response latency bounded and move durable business processing to a queue/job when appropriate.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Acknowledge quickly and process asynchronously when work is non-trivial.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Acknowledge quickly and process asynchronously when work is non-trivial.

rules.title: Make webhook processing idempotent
rules.detail: Use provider event ID or a deterministic business key so retries and duplicate delivery do not duplicate effects.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make webhook processing idempotent.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make webhook processing idempotent.

rules.title: Persist enough evidence for replay and support
rules.detail: Record safe event metadata, processing state, attempts and correlation without storing prohibited secrets or excess personal data.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Persist enough evidence for replay and support.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Persist enough evidence for replay and support.

rules.title: Define retry and dead-letter handling
rules.detail: Failed processing has bounded retry, alerting and a manual or automated recovery path.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define retry and dead-letter handling.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define retry and dead-letter handling.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-WEBHOOK applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Webhook & Event Contracts to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Webhook & Event Contracts is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Webhook & Event Contracts failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
